units: <cite ref="Mishnah Terumot 10:2">Ter. X, 2</cite> <he>תפיח שרְסָקוֹ וכ׳</he> (Y. ed. <he>שרִיסְּקוֹ</he>) an apple chopped and put into dough; Y. Ḥall. I, beg. 57ᵃ.
<cite ref="Makkot 16b:12">Macc. 16ᵇ</cite> <he>רי׳ תשעה וכ׳</he> if he chopped nine ants &c. (v. <cite ref="T00859"><he>רָסַס</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 22:1">Sabb. XXII, 1</cite> <he>חלות דבש שרִיסְּקָן וכ׳</he> honeycomb broken into small pieces &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Oktzin 3:11">Ukts. III, 11</cite> <he>משיְרַסֵּק</he> from the time you break (the honeycomb, to take it out of the hive).
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 24:2">Sabb. XXIV, 2</cite> <he>אין מְרַסְּקִין וכ׳</he> you must not chop grass &c.
<cite ref="Shabbat 51b">Ib. 51ᵇ</cite> <he>אין מְרַסְּקִין וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>מְרַזְּקִין</he>) you must not crush snow or hailstones &c.; a. e.
